verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-retention settings, retention periods, or account/tenant data-deletion controls for Drata. The only related items are per-object API delete endpoints, such as Delete Evidence Library Item, Delete Device, and Delete Custom Connection. Those are ordinary record-management operations, an adjacent feature rather than privacy-posture control over retention and deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
